notes.title: 延迟推出（Delayed launch）
notes.content:
很抱歉，按照原定的计划这个月就要把这个游戏推出

I'm sorry, according to the original plan, this game was going to be released this month.

但因为一些事情耽搁了，对于这款游戏的思考是定位于卡牌游戏，所以考察了市面上所有的卡牌游戏，但还是想做出一些有意义的东西出来

But due to some delays, the game was positioned as a card game, so I looked at all the card games on the market, but I still wanted to make something meaningful.

所以最终决定了一个最新的原创卡牌想法，我会把其他无关紧要的内容先去掉，先把这个核心玩法做好，后面有空再慢慢补上其他的丰富内容

So I finally decided on a new and original card idea. I will remove other irrelevant content first, do this core gameplay first, and then slowly add other rich content later when I have time.


另外这个月还做了一个一款新的游戏APP，也会在近期上线，为了这款游戏以后移植到手机APP上做准备，相信以后还有会更多的内容做出来

In addition, a new game APP was developed this month and will be launched soon. This is to prepare for porting this game to mobile APP in the future. I believe there will be more content in the future.

感谢大家的理解和包容，我会尽力做到最好

Thank you for your understanding and tolerance. I will try my best.

notes.title: Demo has been released （Demo已经发布）
notes.content:
苍天已死，黄天当立，demo已出，速来

正式版本发布应该会在新品节后的这个月底或者下个月初，看更新情况定

下个版本新内容： 增加 拍卖会机制（听泉鉴宝 + 边水往事的赌石）

The demo has been released, you can experience the general gameplay process first, and the specific content is still being continuously updated and improved


The official version should be released after the end of this month's New Product Festival

The next version is coming soon

notes.title: Fully prepare for the October Steam New Product Festival 全力备战10月steam新品节
notes.content:
At present, the game has been approved and can be launched in the early EA version at any time

目前游戏已经审核通过，随时可以上线抢先EA版本
﻿

Due to attending the Steam New Product Festival in October, we can only postpone it for a period of time

由于要参加10月的steam新品节，所以只能再延后一段时间

A trial demo will be released in October and will be directly launched later. The game version will also be continuously updated and will not be delayed due to launch issues

10月会出试玩demo，后面就会直接上线，游戏版本也会一直更新，并不会因为上线问题而耽搁

Let's witness the birth of a great game together!

让我们一起见证一款伟大游戏的诞生吧！


                                                                                                                                    --K5  比心

notes.title: The game is officially launched 游戏正式上线
notes.content:
The game has been changed to an EA pre-test version instead of an official launch, so we need time to review it again, so there's no need to worry too much

目前游戏改为了EA抢先测试版本，而不是正式上线，所以需要时间重新审核一下，不必太过担心

Thank you very much for all the players' attention. This game will activate EA early access mode and gradually update versions and improve content over the course of six months to a year

很感谢所有玩家的关注，这款游戏会开启EA抢先体验模式，在不断更新的半年到一年中会逐渐更新版本，完善内容

Of course, the current popularity of the game is not very high. At the beginning, the game content may be biased towards dialogue, which is a bit boring. Later, a random mechanism of cards and dice was added, hoping that players can have more fun. With the update of the game version, I believe this game will not disappoint you because its gameplay mechanism is innovative and brand new

当然目前游戏的关注热度并不太高，一开始游戏内容可能偏向对话有点无聊，后面就加入了卡牌和骰子的随机机制，希望能够玩家获得更多的乐趣，随着游戏版本的更新，我相信这款游戏并不会让你失望，因为它的玩法机制是首创全新的

Next version preview:
Joining the employee elimination mechanism requires players to make choices among different employees, such as whether to provide compensation and the number of eliminated employees. This is a moral and personnel test

下个版本预告：
加入淘汰员工机制，玩家需要在不同员工中做出取舍，是否发放补偿和淘汰人数，这是一场道德和人选的考验


----K5 blow a kiss 飞吻

notes.title: The game has been approved and the launch date is set for August 31st（游戏通过审核）
notes.content:
The game has been approved and can be launched at any time.
（游戏已经通过审核，随时都可以上线）
It was originally scheduled for the 30th, but there were too many games released that day, which may not make it to the bestseller list
（本来定在30日，但是那天上线发售的游戏太多了，可能无法上热销榜单）
The final decision was made to postpone the release for one day and set it for August 31st. With the vast expanse of stars and the long journey ahead, this has just begun
（最终决定推迟一天，定在8月31日上线发售，星辰大海，前方路途遥远，这才刚刚开始）


                                                                                                                                            --K5 Salute敬礼

notes.title: The game has been submitted for review（游戏已经提交审核）
notes.content:
The game has been submitted for review（游戏已经提交审核）

Although it is quite rushed and many contents are not yet complete, there is a basic gameplay process, and it is hoped that players can continuously iterate versions quickly during the game.

虽然比较匆忙，很多内容还没完善，但是有一个基本游玩的过程，希望在玩家游戏的过程中，不断快速迭代版本。

Traditional game development takes several years to complete and often delays. I hope this game can quickly be introduced to everyone and continuously improve its content

传统的游戏开发一等就要好几年，动不动就跳票，希望这款游戏能够快速和大家见面，并不断完善内容
